scope: Historical quantization diagnosis and bounded precision-policy repair; not full-pipeline or performance qualification

controlled_precision_comparison.conclusion: The actual default Q8_0 and Q4_K quantizations fail the short raw bass waveform comparison. Retaining exactly the four final-decoder matrices in F16 makes both candidates pass all 35 stages on that same input. This is diagnostic evidence for a precision policy, not full-pipeline or performance qualification.
controlled_precision_comparison.policy_status: Measured diagnostic candidate; implementation and full qualification are separate steps.

unchanged_gates.note: All original independent stage metrics are preserved below. Their F16 row statistics are diagnostic and do not alter Q8_0/Q4_K global acceptance.

candidate_policy.rationale: Retain the final spectral reconstruction fusion and three band transposed-convolution matrices in source F16 precision.

mechanism.status: Diagnostic explanation supported by an independent read-only reconstruction and the isolated precision change.
mechanism.hypothesis: Quantizing the final spectral reconstruction matrices perturbs the weak bass spectrum; cancellation between overlapping original frames amplifies relative waveform error. Restoring those four matrices to source F16 removes most of the observed bass error without promoting the rest of the model.

method.capture_layout: decoder2 GGML [T,F,C,1]=[12,2049,16,1], read as C-contiguous [4 stems,2 audio channels,2 real/imag,2049 frequency bins,12 frames]
method.spectrum: Convert recorded F32 decoder2 values and recorded [mean,std] STFT stats to F64; spectrum=decoder2*std+mean; set imaginary DC/Nyquist to zero. Keep original stem order drums,bass,other,vocals.
method.inverse: numpy.fft.irfft(real+1j*imag,n=4096,axis=frequency,norm=ortho), F64 complex arithmetic. No model forward or new quantization.
method.overlap_add: Frame start=t*1024-2048; retain sample indices [0,11025), add inverse frame/count[index]; count includes every overlapping frame.
method.overlap_coherence_ratio: sum((sum_frame contribution)^2) / sum_frame sum(contribution^2), contribution already divided by overlap count. Values below one indicate cancellation between overlapping frame contributions. This is diagnostic only.
method.error_coherence: Apply the same linear reconstruction to (native decoder spectrum-original spectrum) and compare against the existing native-original waveform difference.
method.matrix_storage_error: Read existing GGUF tensors with gguf.quants.dequantize, compare Q8/Q4 dequantized matrices to existing F16 base in F64; no quantization is performed.
method.fusion_fold: For final fusion weight shape[64,576], add matching 288-wide column halves, as native does for repeated input channels.
method.bass_weight_rows: For final transposed-convolution matrix [16*kernel,32], bass channels 4..7 correspond to row slice [4*kernel:8*kernel].
method.reference_denominators: Every signal norm/energy denominator comes from original F32 A; weight-storage denominators explicitly use the F16 model.

interpretation: The default quantized models generate comparable absolute waveform errors across stems, but bass is much quieter and fails its unchanged per-stem relative/cosine gates.

More than 99.997% of bass spectral error occurs in the final low band. Bass overlap contributions cancel more than their quantization errors, increasing waveform relative error compared with spectral relative error.
Independent reconstruction reproduces captured bass waveforms/errors to about 1.4e-9 maximum absolute error, supporting source-consistent ISTFT/cropping/layout rather than a synthesis defect.

All four final decoder matrices use identical Q8_0 storage in both failed default variants. This is compatible with final-head sensitivity but does not, by itself, prove all error originates in those matrices.

Current CPU SCNet matrix routing casts non-F32 weights to F32 when BLAS does not support an operation; ggml-BLAS dequantizes supported weights and uses F32 activations. No native activation quantization is implied by these CPU captures.
The separate four-matrix F16 candidate outcome is recorded elsewhere; no model was modified or run for this receipt. Full default-pipeline fidelity and performance require separate qualification.
